title: Adapters: shared findTaskByRef, emit composite/shortId, accept all refs
summary: Adapters use shared findTaskByRef, emit composite+shortId, advertise ref forms
description:
Update plan-mcp + pi-adapter to use the shared core `findTaskByRef`, emit composite + shortId in tool confirmations (instead of raw UUIDs), and advertise accepted ref forms in tool descriptions.

**Files:**
- packages/plan-mcp/src/index.ts:76 (local `findTaskByRef`) — DELETE the local copy, import `findTaskByRef` from @agent-plan/core. The local version only accepts composite P+T + UUID/shortId/title (no bare T00x). The core version adds bare T00x + composite F/P/T.
- packages/plan-mcp/src/index.ts — all tool handlers that return task/phase/feature confirmations (create_task, task_start, task_complete, task_update, create_phase, phase_update, etc.): emit the composite ref (`F00x/P00x/T00x` or `P00x(F00x)`) + the 5-char shortId in the success message, NOT the raw UUID. Use `taskCompositeRef` helper (L102) + shortId.
- packages/plan-mcp/src/index.ts — tool `description` fields for task/phase tools: advertise accepted refs ("Accepts F00x/P00x/T00x composite, bare P00x/T00x, 5-char shortId, or UUID").
- packages/pi-adapter/src/index.ts:14 import — add `findTaskByRef` from @agent-plan/core; DELETE the local duplicated copy (search for local findTaskByRef). Same confirmation-emission + description changes as plan-mcp.

**Behaviors to preserve:** existing composite format; needsMotivation gating; handoff hygiene; tool parameter names. Only the RESOLUTION + CONFIRMATION TEXT + DESCRIPTIONS change.
